items.subject: Congrats, History Unfolded! You can use advanced YouTube features
items.summary: YouTube verified your ID, so the History Unfolded channel can now use advanced YouTube features.
items.body:
Hi History Unfolded,

Your ID is verified. You can now use advanced YouTube features.

What happens next
* To keep using these features, you'll need to follow our Community Guidelines and maintain a positive channel history.
* You can delete your ID any time. However, if you delete your ID, you won't be able to use advanced YouTube features.

How long we keep your ID
Your ID is automatically deleted from your Google Account within a few months if you built channel history, after 1 year if you haven't used advanced features, and within 2 years at a maximum.

Thanks,
The YouTube team
